subject: Launchpad owners onramp — alignment asks & sign-off timeline
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Launchpad owners onramp — alignment asks & sign-off timeline

Team —

Happy Tuesday. As we edge toward Q1 kickoff I want to lock the owners' OKR slate for the Launchpad initiative and confirm what we surface in the QBR packet. High-level asks:

- Please review the attached Q1-OKR-draft.xlsx and add owner-level metrics + two risk mitigations by EOD Thu (1/12).
- Confirm which two metrics we want on the exec one‑pager (latency P50, total inference cost per 1M tokens, or model throughput).
- Flag any blockers that should be escalated to leadership this week.

I propose the following sign-off cadence: owners submit edits by 1/12, leadership review on 1/15, final sign-off 1/18. If we need to accelerate, call it out in your reply.

I'll pull this into the QBR deck once we have agreed metrics. I know some of you are still collecting telemetry — reasonable to call out provisional numbers for the packet with a clear note.

Thanks —
Michael
Michael Grant
VP, Platform & Operations | Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147

Attachment: Q1-OKR-draft.xlsx (see tabs: Owners, Metrics, Risks)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: michael_grant@redwood.com
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Launchpad owners onramp — alignment asks & sign-off timeline

Thanks Michael — I updated the Owners tab and added provisional targets for throughput and cost. Quick notes:

- Kept latency as a secondary metric for now (we have regional variance that needs normalization).
- Added two mitigations: incremental batching config rollout and a canary rollback policy for quantized models.
- Left an open question in the Risks sheet about sample size for telemetry (Marcus can you weigh in?).

Attachment: Q1-OKR-draft.xlsx (v2 - owners comments)

Date: Fri, 13 Jan 2028 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Launchpad owners onramp — alignment asks & sign-off timeline

Kimberly — good updates. A couple of inline comments in the Owners tab (I quoted below). Short responses:

> "Throughput target (requests/sec) seems aggressive for burst 95th — need to specify steady versus burst."

Agree — let's split throughput into Steady (sustained 95th) and Burst (95th peak). I've suggested numbers in the sheet. Also added a note to quantify cost per 1M tokens using the new batching baseline from Dec.

Two asks for the packet:
- Please include an explicit fallback policy summary (one paragraph) so execs know how we degrade under capacity constraints.
- Naomi: can you confirm the security/compliance note — specifically whether we can call the private deployment option 'available' for pilot customers in Q1?

Michael —

I reviewed the packet and added an exec-readiness paragraph in the Risks tab. Quick answers:

- Security: private deployment option is available for pilots in Q1 pending completed KMS integration (we are on track for 1/31). I called out a small note for legal about data retention defaults.
- Compliance evidence: for the QBR I attached the high-level audit checklist to the Drive link (not included inline).

I've also attached an early QBR deck so the owners can see layout and the one‑pager placeholder. Please point to slide 3 (owner slate + ask).

Attachment: qbr-deck-v0.pptx

Subject: Final sign‑off: Launchpad owners slate (Q1 packet) — APPROVED

Michael / team —

I reviewed the latest Owners tab and the QBR deck. Good work. I'm approving the slate with the caveat that any post‑signoff changes that affect cost estimates must come back for re‑approval. Two final asks:

1) Add the fallback policy paragraph Marcus requested on the one‑pager.
2) Naomi: confirm the KMS line in the packet once integrated (quick email will do).

Once those two items are in place, Michael please pull into the final QBR deck and route to Execs. I'll sign the packet on the DocuSign link once you confirm.

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Strategy & GTM | Redwood Inference
